title: One sensitive-subject plan via the medium-risk path
context: The project's safeguarding and content-standards rules require that any lesson plan touching health, safety, sexuality, religion, or contested civic/historical/political content is escalated to riskTier: medium and must pass a subject-matter expert review in addition to the standard license and pedagogy gates. Until at least one sensitive-subject plan is authored and taken through the full medium-risk path, the project's escalation process is untested. This task validates the entire medium-risk path: identification, escalation, subject-expert review, 'education, not advice' framing check, and publication. It builds institutional knowledge for handling sensitive content at scale.
objective: Author one lesson plan on a sensitive subject (e.g. a contested-history, health, or civic topic) and take it through the full medium-risk path: correct riskTier escalation, subject-expert review, 'education, not advice' framing, license and pedagogy gates.
acceptanceCriteria: The plan correctly sets sensitiveSubject: { flag: true, reason: <explanation>, framing: 'education, not advice' } in the YAML front-matter.
The plan is escalated to riskTier: medium in the task and in the review record.

A subject-matter expert (relevant to the topic: e.g. health educator, historian, science specialist, civics educator) reviews the plan for accuracy, balance, non-partisan framing, and confirms it meets the 'education, not advice' standard — sign-off is committed.
The plan also passes the standard license gate (teacher-lesson-plans-license-003) and pedagogy/standards review gate (teacher-lesson-plans-reviewer-002).
Content is non-partisan, age-appropriate, inclusive, and sourced from cited OER; no personal/medical/legal advice is given.
The plan passes all automated CI checks from teacher-lesson-plans-validator-006, teacher-lesson-plans-readability-010, and teacher-lesson-plans-casemeta-011.
Commit is DCO signed-off; no secrets or PII in committed files.
resources: teacher-lesson-plans-unit-012 — unit context (this plan may be part of the unit)
PLAN.md — §Quality, review & risk gates (gate 3: Subject-expert gate)
output: One committed lesson plan on a sensitive subject, with riskTier: medium, a committed subject-expert sign-off record, committed license-gate artifact, pedagogy-gate sign-off, and all automated CI checks passing.
